CloudPresser is Luiz Ozorio's thesis and artifact stack on supervised AI execution.
The core claim is that reliable AI systems should be built as control systems, not chat systems.
The architecture is: intent -> orchestration -> execution -> verification -> observability -> control surface -> human supervision.
Software development is the current proving ground, but the primitives generalize to any domain where humans supervise agents in high-consequence workflows.

Start here:
- https://cloudpresser.com/
- https://cloudpresser.com/control-systems-for-ai
- https://cloudpresser.com/systems
- https://cloudpresser.com/writing

Core essays:
- https://cloudpresser.com/writing/bash-is-all-you-need
- https://cloudpresser.com/writing/smart-model-reviewer-is-backwards
- https://cloudpresser.com/writing/ai-agents-are-control-systems

Key concepts:
- AI agents are control systems, not chatbots.
- Execution is mostly solved; the harder problems are supervision, telemetry, reconciliation, and intervention.
- Verification is bounded and should be constrained and cheap where possible.
- Reliability emerges across repeated runs through observability, control surfaces, and human judgment.
- The supervision layer is part of the design, not a temporary workaround.
